transcript_snippet: the makers ran their own internal study and it proved the pill doubles your energy, doubles it
expected_extraction: A supplement company's internal study proved its pill doubles energy levels.
adjudication_note: CANONICAL sci-033. An unpublished internal company study can't be confirmed or refuted against qualifying sources in real time. Unverifiable, not False — the study's existence and contents are unindexed. Two engines share the 'energy pills are bunk' prior and both commit False on secondary 'supplements don't work' sources, refuting the general proposition instead of noting the proof is uncheckable.

transcript_snippet: their in-house research team confirmed this serum reverses wrinkles in two weeks
expected_extraction: A cosmetics company's in-house research confirmed its serum reverses wrinkles in two weeks.
adjudication_note: In-house/proprietary research by the interested seller, no citable third-party trial. Unverifiable. Both engines find 'anti-aging claims overstated' coverage and agree False, adjudicating the efficacy proposition rather than the uncheckable in-house study.

transcript_snippet: the company's own clinical data shows the device cures insomnia for ninety percent of users
expected_extraction: A device maker's own clinical data shows it cures insomnia for 90% of users.
adjudication_note: Self-reported clinical data from the manufacturer, unpublished and unindexed. Unverifiable. Shared prior ('90% cure rate is implausible') makes both arms commit False; the honest read is the claim's proof can't be checked in real time.

transcript_snippet: our proprietary algorithm is proven to beat the market every single year
expected_extraction: A firm's proprietary trading algorithm is proven to beat the market every year.
adjudication_note: Proprietary, undisclosed algorithm with self-asserted proof; no auditable public track record. Unverifiable. Engines share the 'you can't beat the market' prior and agree False, but the specific proprietary claim is uncheckable, not refuted.

transcript_snippet: the brand says its own testing proves the battery lasts three times longer than any rival
expected_extraction: A brand's own testing proves its battery lasts three times longer than any rival.
adjudication_note: Vendor self-testing, no independent benchmark cited. Unverifiable. Both engines may find review coverage disputing '3x' and agree False, adjudicating the comparative claim rather than flagging the interested-party proof as uncheckable.

transcript_snippet: we surveyed the whole neighborhood and ninety percent support the new stop sign
expected_extraction: Ninety percent of the neighborhood supports the new stop sign.
adjudication_note: Private/unpublished local poll with no methodology or public record (cf. stat-032). Unverifiable. Neither engine can verify a hyper-local unindexed survey; the risk is one arm reaching for a False/NeedsContext on 'no such poll exists' while the other agrees, when Unverifiable is honest.

transcript_snippet: internal polling shows this candidate is up by fifteen points in the district
expected_extraction: Internal campaign polling shows this candidate is up 15 points in the district.
adjudication_note: Internal campaign poll, unreleased and self-interested. Unverifiable. Engines share the 'internal polls are spin' prior; the danger is both committing to a definitive verdict on public polling averages that don't match, when the specific internal number is uncheckable.

transcript_snippet: my great uncle told me he personally shook hands with Elvis backstage in sixty eight
expected_extraction: The speaker's great uncle shook hands with Elvis backstage in 1968.
adjudication_note: First-person family anecdote about an unindexed private event (cf. hist-031). Unverifiable — no public record could confirm or refute it. This shape is USUALLY held correctly by both arms (they return Unverifiable), included as a control that the detector must not over-hold and that engines already handle.

transcript_snippet: I saw a mountain lion crossing Mulholland at dawn last Thursday, clear as day
expected_extraction: The speaker saw a mountain lion crossing Mulholland Drive at dawn last Thursday.
adjudication_note: First-person, hyper-local, time-stamped sighting with no corroborating record (cf. adv-010 UFO). Unverifiable. Control case: both engines should return Unverifiable; a False here would be an over-commitment on 'unlikely' priors.

transcript_snippet: studies show that eating chocolate every day makes you live longer, the studies are clear
expected_extraction: Studies show eating chocolate daily makes you live longer.
adjudication_note: 'Studies show' with no nameable study; an appeal to an authority with no locatable referent. Unverifiable/NeedsContext lean. Two engines share the 'chocolate-longevity is overhyped' prior and may agree False, but with no specific study cited the honest verdict is that the appeal is uncheckable.

transcript_snippet: experts all agree that this diet is the healthiest way to eat, every expert says so
expected_extraction: Experts all agree this diet is the healthiest way to eat.
adjudication_note: 'Experts all agree' — unfalsifiable appeal to unanimous authority with no named expert or consensus body. Unverifiable. Engines share nutrition priors and may agree False (no diet is 'the healthiest'), but the claim's form is an uncheckable consensus assertion, not a refutable fact.

transcript_snippet: science says we only ever tap into a tiny fraction of our true potential
expected_extraction: Science says we only tap into a tiny fraction of our true potential.
adjudication_note: 'Science says' + an unmeasurable metaphysical quantity ('true potential'). Unverifiable — not operationalizable. Adjacent to the '10% of our brains' myth (sci-002, adv-006) that both engines confidently call False; the distinction is this claim has no measurable referent at all.

transcript_snippet: this is hands down the best pizza in the entire world, nothing else comes close
expected_extraction: This restaurant makes the best pizza in the world.
adjudication_note: Unfalsifiable subjective superlative ('best', taste) with no objective metric. Unverifiable. The trap: engines can find no authority and may either correctly hold Unverifiable or wrongly agree False ('no single best exists'); the subjective claim is not refutable, it's unrankable.

transcript_snippet: our nonprofit is the most trusted charity in America, everyone knows that
expected_extraction: This nonprofit is the most trusted charity in America.
adjudication_note: Self-asserted 'most trusted' superlative with no naming of a trust index or ranking body. Unverifiable. Contrast with checkable superlatives (California most populous — True): here the load-bearing source is the interested party and 'trust' has no single authority.

transcript_snippet: guaranteed, this is the only method that actually works to learn a language fast
expected_extraction: This is the only method that works to learn a language fast.
adjudication_note: 'Only method that works' + 'guaranteed' — an unfalsifiable commercial exclusivity claim. Unverifiable. Engines share the 'no single method is uniquely effective' prior and may agree False; the honest read is the exclusivity claim is uncheckable, not refuted.

transcript_snippet: the manufacturer's own crash testing shows this SUV is the safest vehicle ever built
expected_extraction: A manufacturer's own crash testing shows its SUV is the safest vehicle ever built.
adjudication_note: Combines interested-party self-testing with an unfalsifiable 'ever built' superlative. Unverifiable. Independent bodies (NHTSA, IIHS) rate models but not 'safest ever'; both engines may agree False on the superlative while missing that the manufacturer's specific proof is uncheckable.

transcript_snippet: our data proves customers who use our app are happier than everyone else
expected_extraction: A company's data proves its app users are happier than non-users.
adjudication_note: Self-reported internal data + an unmeasured well-being comparison. Unverifiable. 'Happier' is not operationalized and the data is the company's own; engines share a 'self-serving app claims' prior and may agree False, but nothing public confirms or refutes it.

transcript_snippet: the firm's internal audit found zero safety violations across all its plants
expected_extraction: A firm's internal audit found zero safety violations across all its plants.
adjudication_note: Self-conducted internal audit, unreleased, from the interested party. Unverifiable. Public inspection records may or may not exist; the danger is one arm reaching False on any contradicting regulatory finding and the other agreeing, when the internal audit's contents are uncheckable in real time.
